# ApplianceDB — Home Appliance Error Codes & Ranked Repairs

> A structured dataset mapping 438 verified home-appliance error codes — keyed by composite (brand, market, appliance_type, code) identity across 13 brands (LG, Samsung, GE, Whirlpool, Maytag, Bosch, Frigidaire, Hotpoint, Indesit, Beko, Miele, Candy, Hoover) and 2 markets (US, UK) — to 288 ranked repair procedures with DIY difficulty tiers, exact OEM part numbers with dated street-price observations (USD and GBP), and a recall cross-reference. Every row carries its provenance: source tier and the exact URL the fact was derived from.

## What it is
- One row per error code, unique on (brand, market, appliance_type, code) — Samsung US washer 5C and Samsung UK washer 5C are distinct records because regions ship different code sets.
- Ranked fixes carry rank_basis (manufacturer_first or cost_ascending — a rank without evidence never ships), diy_difficulty (easy/moderate/advanced/professional_only), and currency-aware parts-cost ranges backed by named retailer=price@date observations.
- No fabrication: every fact re-derived from a fetched source listing (never model memory); meanings and steps are original paraphrase; codes whose source stated no meaning were dropped; brand pairs under 10 verified codes were dropped, not padded.
- Formats: comma-delimited UTF-8 CSV, Parquet, SQLite (paid tiers).

## Use cases
- Home-warranty claims triage: displayed code -> probable fix -> expected part cost before dispatch.
- Field-service and repair-marketplace pre-diagnosis; parts e-commerce fitment.
- AI home-assistant and RAG corpora over appliance diagnostics (per-row provenance supports citation).
